name: validate-slice
context_rationale: validate-slice works entirely from file inputs (mission-brief.json, build-log.json, shippability.json) and tool invocations against the live environment; it has no dependency on prior conversation state beyond those artifact files.
summary: Validates the current slice against real environments — real device, real user, real data — going beyond test-suite passing. For each acceptance criterion it executes real-world checks, captures evidence, and classifies results as PASS/FAIL/PARTIAL with failure cause. It runs a shippability catalog regression check via shippability_runner, preceded by SCMD-1, PTFCD-1, and SVW-1 pre-catalog gates plus VAL-1, WS-1, ETC-1 layered audits before handing off to /reflect.

reads.purpose: Primary input: acceptance criteria, verification plan, Walking-skeleton/Exploratory-charter flags.
Confirm the slice was SHIPPED and interpret deviations during AC validation.
Shippability catalog read and executed via canonical runner to check for regressions.
Per-project regex allowlist read by validate_slice_layers Layer A to suppress known-false-positive credential hits.

outputs.purpose: Primary output: per-criterion PASS/FAIL/PARTIAL with evidence and shippability regression notes.
Updated to record stage: validate, result, next-action.
Reality surprises discovered during validation appended immediately via scripts.lib.vault_edit append (SVW-1).
Append reality-surprise findings that spawn future work as new candidates.
Append one gate-outcome row per slice (measurement spine, roadmap Theme 8 / plan Phase 0)

tools.name: wt_root_audit
tools.purpose: WT-ROOT-1 pre-catalog gate: asserts the slice's code (fix + repro test) is in the worktree $wt and the main tree is clean before running the shippability catalog from $wt. Shared with /build-slice.

tools.name: validate_slice_layers
tools.purpose: VAL-1 gate: Layer A credential scan (Critical) and Layer B Python dependency hallucination check (Important).

tools.name: walking_skeleton_audit
tools.purpose: WS-1 gate: verifies every architectural layer was EXERCISED at runtime when Walking-skeleton declared.

tools.name: exploratory_charter_audit
tools.purpose: ETC-1 gate: verifies every charter is COMPLETED or DEFERRED with findings recorded.

tools.name: shippability_decoupling_audit
tools.purpose: SCMD-1 pre-catalog gate: verifies every catalog row carries a prose-free Machine-cmd column.

tools.name: shippability_path_audit
tools.purpose: PTFCD-1 pre-catalog gate: verifies every tests/*.py token in Machine-cmd cells resolves to a file on disk.

tools.name: skill_vault_write_safety_audit
tools.purpose: SVW-1 pre-catalog gate: verifies no SKILL.md prescribes an unrouted mutation of a shared-aggregate vault file.

tools.name: shippability_runner
tools.purpose: SRSC-1 canonical catalog runner: executes each row's Machine-cmd and reports PASS/FAIL to catch regressions.

tools.name: gate_log
tools.purpose: Emit + SVW-1-append one gate-outcome row to gate-log.json (measurement spine, roadmap Theme 8 / plan Phase 0)

tools.name: vault_edit
tools.purpose: SVW-1 locked append of the gate-outcome row to gate-log.json (Phase 0)

harness_tools.name: Read
harness_tools.purpose: Load mission-brief.json, build-log.json, and shippability.json as inputs.

harness_tools.name: Write
harness_tools.purpose: Create validation.json with per-criterion results, evidence, shippability regression notes.

harness_tools.name: Edit
harness_tools.purpose: Update milestone.json with validation stage, result, next-action.

harness_tools.name: Bash
harness_tools.purpose: Execute real-world checks per AC (curl, pytest, CLI runs) and invoke all audit tools.
